question: What is the maximum lump sum group life cover a member can have?

result.question: What is the maximum lump sum group life cover a member can have?
result.answer: The most lump sum group life cover one member can have is R25 000 000, whatever their salary or cover multiple. Cover above a scheme's free cover limit is a separate matter (see caveats).

hit.text:

- The maximum entry age is 64. Cover ends at the scheme's normal retirement age, or age 65 at the latest.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: The member has 60 days from leaving service to get their application to Kestrel. Cover can be up to the lower of their group cover and R5 000 000. This applies to group life cover, and only if they leave before normal retirement age. No medical evidence is needed.

question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?

result.question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?
result.answer: For a disability claim you need: the completed Kestrel disability claim form (employer section and member section), a medical report from the treating doctor, the member's last 3 payslips, and a certified copy of the member's ID document. Submit the claim as soon as possible, and no later than 3 months after the end of the waiting period. The employer or broker can submit it through the Kestrel Broker Portal or by email to claims@kestrel-assurance.example.

caveats: This applies to group life cover only. The documents shown do not describe a continuation option for disability income or funeral cover.
This is the general rule. Whether a particular member qualifies is decided by Kestrel's underwriting or claims team.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text:
A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
Also written as: 5000000, R5000000

question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?

result.question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?
result.answer: Under Option C, a member on a monthly salary of R50 000 would get R42 500 a month. This is the general rule applied to the example figure. Option C pays 100% of the first R20 000 of monthly salary plus 75% of the balance. The benefit is capped at R300 000 a month, and the R42 500 is well below that cap. It starts after a 3-month waiting period.

result.question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?

question: Is there a waiting period on extended family funeral cover?

result.question: Is there a waiting period on extended family funeral cover?
result.answer: Yes. Extended family members have a 6-month waiting period for death from natural causes. Death from accidental causes is covered immediately. The main member, spouse and children have no waiting period.

question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?

result.question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?
result.answer: A disability claim needs these documents: the completed Kestrel disability claim form (employer section and member section), a medical report from the treating doctor, the member's last 3 payslips, and a certified copy of the member's ID document. The claim should be sent as soon as possible and no later than 3 months after the end of the waiting period. The employer or broker can send it through the Kestrel Broker Portal, or by email to claims@kestrel-assurance.example.

result.question: What is the maximum lump sum group life cover a member can have?
result.answer: The most lump sum group life cover one member can have is R25 000 000, whatever their salary or cover multiple. Within that cap, the employer chooses a cover multiple of 1x to 5x annual pensionable salary, in whole multiples.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: For group life cover, a member who leaves service before normal retirement age has 60 days from leaving to get their application to Kestrel. They don't need to give medical evidence. Continued cover is limited to the lower of their group cover and R5 000 000.

citations.label: c1
citations.quote: The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.supports: 60-day deadline and cover limit
citations.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)

citations.label: c1
citations.quote: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence.
citations.supports: Applies to members leaving before normal retirement age; no medical evidence; individual policy
citations.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)

caveats: This is the group life continuation option. The documents shown do not describe a continuation option for group disability income or funeral cover.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text:
A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
Also written as: 5000000, R5000000

question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?

result.question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?
result.answer: Under Option C, a member with a monthly salary of R50 000 would get a monthly benefit of R42 500. This is 100% of the first R20 000 (R20 000) plus 75% of the remaining R30 000 (R22 500). It is below the Option C maximum of R300 000 a month. This illustrates the general rule using the figures given. The claims team decides what an actual member receives.

result.question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?
